interpretation: Day 24 validates the technical 3D rigid MI path on the prepared real RIRE CT/MR-T1 pair: both initializations execute, return plausible rigid transforms, preserve the fixed CT output geometry, and satisfy metadata checks. The two initialization paths converge to very similar transforms and final MI values, which supports initialization consistency for this pair. Geometry initialization is more efficient here, but no anatomical accuracy ranking is claimed. The decrease in physical field-of-view coverage after registration is preserved as a limitation and requires caution because physical domain overlap is not anatomical ground truth.
decision: Mark Day 24 complete as a technical real-data validation. Keep geometry initialization as the primary documented path for this pair because it converged to essentially the same solution as identity with fewer iterations and lower runtime. Do not add a 3D affine extension solely to improve visual or overlap diagnostics. Proceed to Day 25 integrated Week 5 benchmarking while preserving the no-TRE, no-Dice, and no-anatomical-correctness limitation for the real RIRE pair.
